base_url.correction: PostHog uses separate bases: https://us.i.posthog.com for US public ingestion/flag endpoints and https://us.posthog.com for US private endpoints; EU uses the corresponding eu.i.posthog.com and eu.posthog.com hosts.

free_tier_limits.correction: Published monthly limits include 1 million analytics events, 5,000 session recordings, and 1 million feature-flag requests; other products have separate limits.

rate_limits.correction: Published private-API limits include analytics 240/minute and 1,200/hour; events/values 60/minute and 300/hour; query 2,400/hour; local flag evaluation 600/minute; other CRUD endpoints 480/minute and 4,800/hour. Public POST-only endpoints have no request-level limit.

example.correction: The shown request uses the public-ingestion host for a private API route and omits authentication. A current projects request is: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <PERSONAL_API_KEY>" https://us.posthog.com/api/organizations/<organization_id>/projects/

notes: The API is operational, but the entry conflates public and private API hosts. Its example is invalid, and both free-tier limits and endpoint-specific rate limits are currently published. No definitive official general CORS policy was located.
